mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, generation, target_model_config_id, target_embedding_model, index_version, status, members_frozen_at, created_at, created_by FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, generation, target_model_config_id, target_embedding_model, index_version, status, members_frozen_at, created_at, created_by FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{rebuildId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_index_rebuild SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND id = #{rebuildId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_index_rebuild_member ( tenant_id, rebuild_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, document_updated_at, expected_chunk_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{rebuildId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{documentUpdatedAt}, #{expectedChunkCount}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, rebuild_id, document_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_index_desired ( tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, desired_rebuild_id, desired_generation, next_generation_required, requested_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{rebuildId}, #{generation}, #{nextGenerationRequired}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id) DO UPDATE SET desired_rebuild_id = EXCLUDED.desired_rebuild_id, desired_generation = EXCLUDED.desired_generation, next_generation_required = EXCLUDED.next_generation_required, requested_by = EXCLUDED.requested_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, version = kb_knowledge_index_desired.version + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_index_desired SET next_generation_required = true, requested_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}
mapper.select: SELECT member.document_id FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild_member member JOIN kb_document document ON document.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND document.knowledge_base_id = member.knowledge_base_id AND document.id = member.document_id WHERE member.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member.rebuild_id = #{rebuildId} AND member.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY member.document_id FOR UPDATE OF member, document

SELECT member.document_id FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild_member member JOIN kb_document document ON document.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND document.knowledge_base_id = member.knowledge_base_id AND document.id = member.document_id AND document.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE member.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member.rebuild_id = #{rebuildId} AND member.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND member.document_id = #{documentId} AND member.document_updated_at = #{documentUpdatedAt} AND member.expected_chunk_count = ( SELECT count(*) FROM kb_document_chunk chunk WHERE chunk.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND chunk.knowledge_base_id = member.knowledge_base_id AND chunk.document_id = member.document_id AND chunk.status = 'ACTIVE' AND chunk.deleted_at IS NULL ) FOR UPDATE OF member, document

WITH locked_plan AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT plan.id, plan.tenant_id, plan.knowledge_base_id, plan.generation, plan.target_embedding_model, plan.index_version FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild plan JOIN kb_knowledge_index_desired desired ON desired.tenant_id = plan.tenant_id AND desired.knowledge_base_id = plan.knowledge_base_id WHERE plan.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND plan.id = #{rebuildId} AND plan.generation = #{generation} AND plan.status = 'ACTIVE' AND desired.desired_rebuild_id = plan.id AND desired.desired_generation = plan.generation FOR UPDATE OF plan, desired ), eligible_plan AS ( SELECT plan.* FROM locked_plan plan WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild_member member WHERE member.tenant_id = plan.tenant_id AND member.rebuild_id = plan.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild_member member LEFT JOIN kb_document document ON document.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND document.knowledge_base_id = member.knowledge_base_id AND document.id = member.document_id AND document.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE member.tenant_id = plan.tenant_id AND member.rebuild_id = plan.id AND ( document.id IS NULL OR member.document_updated_at = document.updated_at IS NOT TRUE OR document.parse_status NOT IN ('CHUNKED', 'VECTORIZING', 'AVAILABLE') OR member.expected_chunk_count <> ( SELECT count(*) FROM kb_document_chunk chunk WHERE chunk.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND chunk.knowledge_base_id = member.knowledge_base_id AND chunk.document_id = member.document_id AND chunk.status = 'ACTIVE' AND chunk.deleted_at IS NULL ) OR member.expected_chunk_count <> ( SELECT count(DISTINCT candidate.chunk_id) FROM kb_document_chunk chunk JOIN kb_document_chunk_embedding candidate ON candidate.tenant_id = chunk.tenant_id AND candidate.knowledge_base_id = chunk.knowledge_base_id AND candidate.document_id = chunk.document_id AND candidate.chunk_id = chunk.id WHERE chunk.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND chunk.knowledge_base_id = member.knowledge_base_id AND chunk.document_id = member.document_id AND chunk.status = 'ACTIVE' AND chunk.deleted_at IS NULL AND candidate.embedding_model = plan.target_embedding_model AND candidate.index_version = plan.index_version ) ) ) ), activated AS ( INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_index_active ( tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, embedding_model, active_index_version, activated_at, activated_by, updated_at, updated_by ) SELECT tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, target_embedding_model, index_version, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId} FROM eligible_plan ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id) DO UPDATE SET embedding_model = EXCLUDED.embedding_model, active_index_version = EXCLUDED.active_index_version, activated_at = EXCLUDED.activated_at, activated_by = EXCLUDED.activated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, version = kb_knowledge_index_active.version + 1 RETURNING tenant_id, knowledge_base_id ), completed AS ( UPDATE kb_knowledge_index_rebuild rebuild SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, version = rebuild.version + 1 FROM activated WHERE rebuild.tenant_id = activated.tenant_id AND rebuild.knowledge_base_id = activated.knowledge_base_id AND rebuild.id = #{rebuildId} AND rebuild.status = 'ACTIVE' RETURNING rebuild.id ), available_documents AS ( UPDATE kb_document document SET parse_status = 'AVAILABLE', updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, version = document.version + 1 FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild_member member, completed rebuild WHERE member.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member.rebuild_id = rebuild.id AND document.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND document.knowledge_base_id = member.knowledge_base_id AND document.id = member.document_id AND document.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING document.id ) SELECT rebuild.id FROM completed rebuild WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM available_documents) >= 0
